papers.title: T2-z: Test-Time Optimization of Environment Latents for Robotic World Models
papers.abstract: Predicting how the world responds to an action requires more than what can be seen: robots must account for environmental factors that are neither directly observable nor explicitly specified, from physical properties such as friction and mass to human-defined environmental rules. We introduce T2-Z for test-time optimization of environment latents, which augments a robotic world model with a learnable environment latent to condition world predictions. This compact latent captures underlying environmental variation without supervision of what environmental factors exist or what values they take. During training, T2-Z alternates between two stages: a world-model optimization stage that fixes the latents and learns general action-conditioned dynamics across environments; and an environment-latent optimization stage that freezes the world model and optimizes the conditioning latents, allowing latent structure to emerge purely through world prediction. At test time, the world model remains frozen and a newly initialized environment latent is optimized from one or more test-time interactions, adapting the model to previously unseen environmental configurations. Across 7 simulated settings and 4 real-world robotic tasks, T2-Z reduces object prediction error metric from 15.20 to 7.00 and raises action success from 33.73% to 72.96%. Its emergent latents capture structured representations of individual and compounded factors across diverse visual scenes. Ablations further show that T2-Z can efficiently infer environment latents from as little as a single test-time interaction trajectory.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人世界模型在预测动作后果时，无法考虑摩擦、质量、人类设定的环境规则等既不可直接观测、也未被显式指定的环境因素，导致在训练分布之外的环境配置下预测不准、动作成功率低。
ai_summary.method: 提出 T2-Z：为世界模型额外引入一个紧凑的可学习环境潜变量，用来调制动作条件动力学预测。训练时交替进行两个阶段：先固定潜变量、训练世界模型学习跨环境的通用动力学；再冻结世界模型、只优化环境潜变量，使潜变量结构完全由世界预测任务驱动。测试时世界模型保持冻结，仅用一条或少数几条测试交互轨迹重新初始化并优化环境潜变量，从而适配未见过的环境配置，无需任何环境因素标签。
ai_summary.result: 在 7 个仿真设置和 4 个真实机器人任务中，物体预测误差指标从 15.20 降到 7.00，动作成功率从 33.73% 提升到 72.96%；消融实验显示，仅凭单条测试交互轨迹即可高效推断环境潜变量，并且涌现出的潜变量能在多样视觉场景中结构化地表示单一及复合环境因素。
ai_summary.novelty: 把“环境是什么”作为潜变量，在测试时通过自监督世界预测在线优化，无需预定义环境因素类别或监督信号，即可隐式辨识环境并适配新环境。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人世界模型与具身智能提供了一种通用的测试时自适应范式，显著提升跨环境泛化与真实部署鲁棒性，并可扩展到其他需要隐式上下文推断的序列决策任务。
ai_summary.org: 提供的信息中未标注作者机构；从作者阵容看，可能主要来自 Stanford University 等机构

papers.title: Perceive, Predict, and Plan: a Unified World Action Model for Egocentric Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文希望统一建模第一视角灵巧操作中的3D感知、动作条件预测和目标导向规划，避免为不同任务分别训练专用模型。
ai_summary.method: 提出P3-WAM统一世界动作模型，通过Perceive、Predict、Plan三种互补模式，将紧凑结构化的3D动作表示接入预训练视频扩散Transformer。模型采用共享基础权重、模态特定适配和双向视觉-动作注意力的混合Transformer架构，并通过随机模态可见性让视频与3D动作在条件上下文和预测目标之间切换。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明，统一训练在三种能力上均优于单模式训练；在3D手部重建和动作条件视频预测上超过专用基线，并且生成的目视操作视频在指令遵循和动作推进方面优于视频生成基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是将3D灵巧手动作与视频扩散世界模型以统一混合Transformer框架联合训练，并在同一模型中统一感知、预测与规划。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作推动了面向具身智能的世界动作模型发展，为第一视角灵巧操作中的感知、预测与规划一体化提供了新范式。

papers.title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
papers.abstract: Generative simulation can automate robot environment construction, but physically valid environments are not necessarily useful for training. The challenge is to identify environments that address a policy's failures and supervision that helps it overcome them. We introduce CoDA, a framework in which a simulation data engine and an action policy co-evolve through a shared heterogeneous memory of environment construction, policy failures, and learning progress. The memory compiles validated diagnoses from a vision-language critic into generation programs that recreate difficulties and training programs that help the policy overcome them. We further propose Text2potential to convert these diagnoses into staged potentials for action-chunk value learning, providing dense supervision for policy updates while preserving the task's optimal policy under standard shaping assumptions. Measured learning progress guides further generation and program refinement. Across four manipulation task families, CoDA improves out-of-distribution success from 5.3% after supervised fine-tuning to 27.6%, exceeding the strongest closed-loop baseline by 9.5 percentage points with the same generation budget. On LIBERO-Pro, 15 rounds of generation and training raise success from 25% to 84% under position perturbations and from 1% to 76% under instruction perturbations.

ai_summary.problem: 生成式仿真虽然能自动构建机器人环境，但物理上有效的环境未必对策略训练有用；难点在于如何定位能暴露策略失败的环境，并生成帮助策略克服这些失败的监督信号。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CoDA 框架，让仿真数据引擎与动作策略通过一个共享的异构记忆（记录环境构建、策略失败和学习进展）共同演化：视觉-语言批评器给出经验证诊断，记忆将其编译为复现困难的环境生成程序与针对性训练程序；并提出 Text2potential 把诊断转化为分阶段势函数，用于动作块价值学习，从而提供稠密监督且保持最优策略不变，以实测学习进展指导后续生成与程序改进。
ai_summary.result: 在四个操作任务族上，分布外成功率从监督微调后的 5.3% 提升到 27.6%，在相同生成预算下超过最强闭环基线 9.5 个百分点；在 LIBERO-Pro 上，15 轮生成与训练使位置扰动下成功率从 25% 升至 84%，指令扰动下从 1% 升至 76%。
ai_summary.novelty: 把数据引擎与策略放在同一闭环中协同演化，并用 Text2potential 将失败诊断转化为保持最优性的分阶段势函数奖励，实现'缺什么补什么'的定向数据生成与稠密监督。
ai_summary.relevance: 为机器人策略学习中的自动化课程生成、失败驱动数据合成与强化学习奖励塑形提供了可复用的闭环范式，对具身智能与世界模型训练有直接启发。

papers.title: Grounding Generative Verification in 3D Content
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型与3D生成虽在视觉保真度上进展显著，但缺乏基于3D证据的任务特定正确性验证能力，难以识别未满足的需求并解释违规原因。
ai_summary.method: 提出3DVerifierBench基准，涵盖10个任务，评估模型决策、拒绝解释及对规格和候选变化的响应；并构建结合多视角事实抽取、受控3D编辑与原生标注的可扩展pipeline，生成14,126条带矛盾解释和关联反事实的训练样本。
ai_summary.result: 人类与最强模型GPT-6 Astra存在21.6个百分点差距，拒绝可靠性存在明显弱点；在人工标注的16候选池中Oracle选择将完整事实成功率从26.7%提升至90.0%，人类引导的递归优化可使所有输入满足全部七项要求。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地将3D内容的生成验证形式化为基于多视角证据的可解释反馈问题，并提供基准、细粒度错误分析与可扩展训练数据管线。
ai_summary.relevance: 为3D生成与理解系统引入可靠验证反馈机制，推动模型自我反思与迭代优化，对世界模型和具身智能的可信构建具有基础意义。

papers.title: Dexterity from Supervised Play
papers.abstract: How can robots autonomously collect the contact-rich experience needed to learn dexterous manipulation? We present DSP: Dexterity from supervised play, a framework in which a robot learns a play policy from minutes of human play through behavior cloning, then deploys it autonomously to collect hours of interaction data to train a world model. During inference, the same play policy then guides model-predictive control (MPC) by proposing candidate action sequences for evaluation under the learned world model. To accelerate inference, we also introduce a method for distilling a closed-loop, goal-conditioned policy through self-play within the learned world model. We evaluate this framework on underactuated pushing and any-to-any in-hand pose reorientation with a multifingered hand, in simulation and real world. In real world experiment, our method outperforms hindsight behavior cloning by 69.6% in success rate and achieves comparable success to reinforcement learning with 490 times less interaction data. These results demonstrate that supervised play can autonomously collect interaction data, guide model-based planning, and enable policy learning without any task-specific demonstrations or sim-to-real transfer.

ai_summary.problem: 如何让机器人无需任务特定示范，自主采集接触丰富的交互数据，以学习灵巧操作策略。
ai_summary.method: 提出DSP框架：先用少量人类玩耍数据通过行为克隆学习play policy，再让机器人自主执行以收集数小时数据并训练世界模型；推理时用该策略为MPC提出候选动作，并通过在世界模型中的自博弈蒸馏闭环目标条件策略以加速推理。
ai_summary.result: 在欠驱动推物和多指手任意姿态重定向任务上，真实实验成功率比 hindsight behavior cloning 高69.6%，并以约490倍更少交互数据达到与强化学习相当的效果。
ai_summary.novelty: 将监督式“玩耍”策略同时用于自主数据采集、世界模型训练和模型预测控制，并可自博弈蒸馏出快速闭环策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了利用世界模型与自主交互数据学习灵巧操作的可扩展路径，对具身智能和机器人世界模型研究有重要意义。
ai_summary.org: 加州大学伯克利分校等

papers.title: Velox: Spatial Memory Makes World Models Efficient
papers.abstract: Video world models turn actions and camera motion into long visual rollouts, making video a natural interface for interactive simulation. Such interaction requires responsive generation, yet coherent rollouts must retain visual memory of what has already been generated. Chunked video diffusion models usually keep this context in growing KV caches, so later chunks become progressively slower. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Velox, a training-free attention router for region-level context selection using frustum slab correspondences from streaming geometry. Velox represents historical blocks as camera frustum slabs with depth intervals and obtains current-block depth through recency-priority multiwarp. For well-covered regions, frustum slab overlap softly modulates each layer's model-derived block importance. Uncovered regions retain the model-derived route without geometric bias. The fixed token-block granularity matches FlashAttention-style tiled execution and reduces the attention term that grows with rollout length. Frustum slab construction runs asynchronously with denoising on the same H200. At chunk 48, Velox accelerates attention by $4.36\times$ and denoising by $2.43\times$. On the full 158-case WBench navigation split, it remains within 0.15 API-free average points of dense LingBot-Fast-Cam. Please see our project page at https://velox-world.com/velox/ for more details.

ai_summary.problem: 分块视频扩散世界模型在长序列生成中需要保留已生成内容的视觉记忆，但不断增长的 KV cache 会让后续分块越来越慢，难以满足交互式模拟的实时响应需求。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Velox，一种无需训练的注意力路由器，利用流式几何中的视锥板（frustum slab）对应关系进行区域级上下文选择；将历史块表示为带深度区间的相机视锥板，并通过 recency-priority multiwarp 获取当前块深度，对覆盖良好区域用视锥板重叠软调制各层块重要性，未覆盖区域保持模型原始路由；固定 token-block 粒度匹配 FlashAttention 式分块执行，且视锥板构建与去噪异步运行。
ai_summary.result: 在第 48 个分块时，Velox 将注意力加速 4.36 倍、去噪加速 2.43 倍；在完整 158 例 WBench 导航划分上，与稠密 LingBot-Fast-Cam 的平均分差距在 0.15 分以内。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是无需训练、基于流式几何视锥板对应关系的区域级注意力路由，用空间记忆选择上下文以降低随 rollout 长度增长的注意力开销。
ai_summary.relevance: 该方法提升了长时程交互式视频世界模型的生成效率，对世界模型、视频扩散和多模态交互仿真有直接意义。

papers.title: OS-Helix: Unifying GUI Interaction and Code Execution in Native Computer-Using Agents
papers.abstract: Real desktop automation is neither purely visual nor purely programmatic. Agents must understand user-facing interfaces while efficiently manipulating files, scripts, and system state. However, native GUI/code coordination cannot be obtained by prompt-level tool composition. In our preliminary experiments, naively adding a code tool degrades a GUI agent, revealing that GUI/code routing must be internalized through training on high-quality hybrid data. We present OS-Helix, an end-to-end trained multimodal computer-using agent that unifies GUI actions and code execution in one action space. To construct the required supervision, we introduce application-artifact composition, pairing desktop applications with authentic file artifacts to instantiate executable Ubuntu states, and a decoupled instruction/evaluator generation pipeline that produces environment-grounded tasks whose final states can be verified regardless of the solution modality. We cold-start the policy with SFT on filtered hybrid data and further improve it through online RL in live desktop environments. For RL, we propose Step-balanced GSPO, which aggregates importance weight by action step rather than raw assistant tokens to prevent long code actions from dominating heterogeneous-action optimization. On OSWorld-Verified, OS-Helix-27B and OS-Helix-35B-A3B achieve relative improvements of 35.0% and 33.7% over their matched Qwen3.5 hybrid baselines, while OS-Helix-27B-RL further improves by 42.9% to reach 66.44% success. Ablations provide evidence consistent with contributions from learned GUI/code coordination, scalable verifiable supervision, and action step balanced optimization, while demonstrating cross-platform transfer on WindowsAgentArena. Our project homepage is at https://os-copilot.github.io/OS-Helix/.

ai_summary.problem: 真实桌面自动化需要同时理解GUI界面并高效执行代码/文件操作，但简单通过提示词组合GUI与代码工具反而会降低GUI Agent性能，核心问题是GUI/代码协调能力必须通过高质量混合数据训练内化。
ai_summary.method: 提出OS-Helix，一个端到端训练的多模态Computer-Using Agent，将GUI动作与代码执行统一到同一动作空间；通过application-artifact composition构造可执行Ubuntu状态，并用解耦的指令/评估器生成可验证任务；先SFT冷启动，再在真实桌面环境中在线RL，并提出按动作步聚合重要性权重的Step-balanced GSPO。
ai_summary.result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，OS-Helix-27B和OS-Helix-35B-A3B相对匹配的Qwen3.5 hybrid基线分别提升35.0%和33.7%；OS-Helix-27B-RL进一步提升42.9%，达到66.44%成功率，并在WindowsAgentArena上展示跨平台迁移。
ai_summary.novelty: 将GUI交互与代码执行统一建模，并结合可扩展可验证混合监督与动作步平衡RL优化，解决异构动作空间中长代码动作主导训练的问题。
ai_summary.relevance: 为原生Computer-Using Agent提供可训练、可验证的GUI/代码协同范式，推动桌面自动化Agent从提示词工具编排走向端到端能力内化。

papers.title: FutureLift: Lifting Trajectory Proposals into Bidirectional Future Graphs for Motion Forecasting
papers.abstract: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.

ai_summary.problem: 运动预测中即使强预测器也会在多模态轨迹提案中留下残差误差，现有细化器无法把完整未来轨迹作为显式关系上下文来校正。
ai_summary.method: FutureLift 是一种与主干无关的细化器，将每个多模态提案表示为异质未来图：时空节点连接智能体历史、地图元素、备选模式及其他智能体未来轨迹；双向时间边允许后段证据单次修正前段，并由更新节点预测坐标与置信度残差。
ai_summary.result: 在 Argoverse2 和 Waymo Open Motion Dataset 上，FutureLift 稳定提升冻结提案，并在边际与联合预测中优于原生及专用细化器；在 WOMD 排行榜标准输入方法中取得 minADE 0.5049m、minFDE 0.9942m 第一，Soft mAP 0.4874，且无需 LiDAR 或集成。
ai_summary.novelty: 将完整多模态未来提案提升为双向异质未来图，以显式关系上下文进行一次性残差校正。
ai_summary.relevance: 为不同运动预测主干提供通用即插即用细化接口，有助于提升自动驾驶安全关键场景的预测精度。

papers.title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. A common approach fuses 3D reconstruction features into visual tokens, but aligning these features with pretrained semantic representations remains challenging under limited spatial supervision. We propose DK-VLM with Dual-Kernel Attention, which computes attention from both a visual token's input position and its geometric position in the scene. A semantic kernel retains the pretrained model's native attention and positional encoding, while a separate geometric kernel uses estimated 3D points and camera poses to directly modulate attention through point displacements and relative view transformations. Then, a learned gate fuses their outputs. Geometry thus enters attention as position rather than as fused reconstruction features. We further introduce Reference-Frame Composition (RC) supervision to train the model to update its reference frame across successive judgments. It provides stepwise turn and heading targets derived from verified single-step annotations. Among the compared methods, DK-VLM-8B achieves the highest average score across six spatial benchmarks and the highest overall scores on VSI-Bench (74.33) and ReVSI-32 (58.28). RC supervision further improves multi-step spatial reasoning, while the full model preserves general video understanding. Project page: https://sumuru789.github.io/DK-VLM-website/.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在跨视角3D空间关系理解和观察者移动后的空间判断更新方面仍较弱。
ai_summary.method: 提出DK-VLM与双核注意力，将视觉token的语义位置与基于3D点和相机位姿的几何位置分别建模为注意力核，并通过学习门控融合。还引入Reference-Frame Composition监督，用单步标注构造逐步转向与朝向目标，训练模型更新参考系。
ai_summary.result: DK-VLM-8B在六个空间基准上取得最高平均分，在VSI-Bench和ReVSI-32上分别达到74.33和58.28；RC监督进一步提升多步空间推理，同时保留通用视频理解能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是把几何信息作为注意力中的位置而非融合的重建特征，并用参考系组合监督训练多步空间判断更新。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉语言模型注入3D几何与视角变换提供新路径，有望推动具身智能和多模态空间推理发展。

contacts.name: Han Su
contacts.affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology; Yinwang Intelligent Technology

papers.title: OmniVerifier-C1: Decomposed Graded Verifier for Rule-Governed Generative World Modeling
papers.abstract: Generative visual verifiers play a crucial role in advancing multimodal intelligence. To enhance the robustness of visual verifiers in complex multimodal scenarios involving compositional requirements, we move beyond conventional binary verifiers that produce only True/False discrete judgments and introduce a verifier that automatically decomposes complex prompts or environmental rules into fine-grained components and assigns pointwise scores to provide a continuous and more informative critique signal. Our experiments further demonstrate that these structured and interpretable outputs improve the verifier's generalization to out-of-domain multimodal critic tasks. To train this verifier, we introduce a Decoupled RL training strategy that jointly optimizes sub-question-level binary judgment and global alignment scoring, using precise local feedback to develop fine-grained verification capabilities that provide a foundation for reliable continuous scoring at the global level. Under a general reinforcement learning framework, we first empirically demonstrate that the proposed pointwise graded verifier significantly outperforms binary verifiers in traditional text-to-image scenarios. We then extend our investigation to rule-governed generative world modeling where generative models are leveraged for world simulation and world reasoning under explicit rules. From a theoretical standpoint, we further show that a pairwise verification paradigm yields more accurate critiques than the pointwise formulation when ground-truth images are available, with empirical results on diverse structured world-modeling tasks such as Maze and Sudoku further validating the effectiveness of our approach. Overall, our findings suggest a key insight: the transition from generative models to structured world-modeling agents critically hinges on the availability of accurate pairwise graded visual verifiers.

ai_summary.problem: 传统视觉验证器只能输出二值 True/False 判断，难以应对涉及组合式要求与显式规则的复杂多模态评判场景，缺乏连续且可解释的反馈信号。
ai_summary.method: 提出 OmniVerifier-C1，将复杂提示或环境规则自动分解为细粒度子问题并逐点打分，给出连续可解释的评判；采用解耦的强化学习训练策略，联合优化子问题级二值判断与全局对齐打分，并进一步分析点式与成对式验证范式的理论差异。
ai_summary.result: 在传统文生图任务中，逐点分级验证器显著优于二值验证器；在 Maze、Sudoku 等规则驱动的世界建模任务上，成对式分级验证在存在真值图像时更准确，实验验证了方法的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将验证器从二值判别升级为「规则分解 + 逐点评分」的结构化分级评判，并用解耦 RL 训练与点式/成对式范式对比给出理论与实证支撑。
ai_summary.relevance: 为生成式世界模型与结构化世界建模 Agent 提供了可靠、可解释的评判基础，指明精确的成对分级视觉验证器是迈向世界建模智能体的关键环节。

papers.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
papers.abstract: Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/

ai_summary.problem: 现有3D世界模型直接把几何基础模型（GFM）的特征当作预测用的世界状态，但这些特征与视角强相关，导致场景动态变化与相机引起的观测变化纠缠在一起，使状态演化难以预测。
ai_summary.method: 提出GeoState，一种视角解耦的几何表示：场景tokenizer将多视角GFM特征聚合为与视角无关的场景状态，几何解码器用相机射线对该状态进行查询解码；自回归世界模型只预测未来场景状态，相机运动则单独建模。
ai_summary.result: 在Waymo上优于已有3D世界模型，支持几何一致的跨视角查询，并能零样本泛化到KITTI和nuScenes；整个rollout过程中保持单一由上下文推导的尺度，无需逐帧尺度对齐。
ai_summary.novelty: 将场景状态演化与相机观测解耦，使GFM特征成为可预测、可任意相机解码的视角无关世界状态。
ai_summary.relevance: 为自动驾驶与具身智能中可预测、可控视角的3D世界模型提供了更清晰的状态表示范式。

papers.title: Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition in Videos
papers.abstract: Understanding characteristics and activities of individuals in complex multi-person environments is crucial for real-world applications. However, existing datasets often simplify this problem to grounded group activity recognition, single-person activity recognition, or close-set activity recognition, thus limiting the generalizability of models trained on these datasets. In this work, we introduce the task of Grounded Human-Attributed Description and Activity Recognition (GHADAR), which involves describing the characteristics and activity descriptions of \textbf{every} person in a video, provided the location of the person in the video, which is more practical for real-world applications. To facilitate this, we introduce a new dataset derived from AVA-Actions by generating open-set captions for the person description and activity. In addition, we propose a novel method to effectively utilize the information contained in grounding during training by constraining the cross-attention masks during training in VLMs to improve performance for this task. Our experiments show that our method outperforms SOTA VLMs on this task. Finally, we demonstrate the limitations of existing evaluation metrics, which are overly reliant on human-annotations and exact text-text matching. As an added video-based evaluation, we propose a holistic VLM-based evaluation schema that compares concepts {\em directly} between the video and the generated predictions. Thus, in this work, we develop a complete framework for GHADAR, including a dataset, a novel method and an evaluation schema, thereby establishing a strong foundation for future research in this domain.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视频理解数据集多将多人场景简化为群体活动识别、单人活动识别或闭集活动识别，难以泛化到真实世界中需要对视频中每个人进行定位并描述其属性与活动。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出GHADAR任务：给定视频中每个人的位置，生成该人的属性描述和活动描述；基于AVA-Actions构建带开放集描述的新数据集，并在VLM训练中通过约束cross-attention masks来利用定位信息；同时提出基于VLM的整体评估方案，直接比较视频与预测中的概念。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明该方法在该任务上优于现有SOTA VLM，并指出现有评估指标过度依赖人工标注和精确文本匹配的局限，提出的VLM评估 schema 可作为补充。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地提出并构建GHADAR任务、数据集、定位约束训练方法和VLM评估框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多人视频理解、开放集人物属性与活动识别以及更贴近真实应用的视频VLM评测提供了新基准和方法基础。

papers.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence lets an agent perceive and act in the physical world, and many of its judgments must be made at interaction rates: which spatial relation holds, how far an object is, or where to place it. Vision-language models (VLMs) produce these answers by free-form text generation, paying for autoregressive decoding and answer parsing even though the output space is compact: one of a few options, a scalar, or a 2D point. In light of this, we introduce MJev-Spatial, a System 1 multimodal decision model that tackles all three types of spatial understanding tasks within a unified classification framework. Specifically, MJev-Spatial treats each candidate as a class and scores it using the backbone's pretrained query and key projections, without adding parameters. The candidates are the given options for choice tasks, or value bins and image regions refined through coarse-to-fine classification for numerical and point prediction, respectively. At inference, each classification decision takes a single forward pass and generates no answer tokens. To train on heterogeneous spatial data efficiently, we supervise all coarse-to-fine stages jointly with teacher forcing in one forward pass, and combine this with length-aware global batching and cross-GPU load balancing, raising training throughput by 30.8% over the original batching strategy. Built on Qwen3.5-4B and trained on 12.3M question-answer pairs converted from existing spatial datasets, MJev-Spatial achieves the highest overall score (65.64%) among eight tested models, ranks first on seven of twelve benchmarks, and outperforms its unmodified autoregressive base model on all twelve, while running 2.5 times faster than the fastest autoregressive baseline and 5.6 times faster than the base model.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型做空间理解任务时通常依赖自回归文本生成，即使输出空间很小（选项、标量或二维点），也会带来解码和答案解析开销。论文旨在用更高效的原生分类方式统一处理空间关系、距离数值和位置点预测。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MJev-Spatial，将所有空间理解任务统一为分类框架：把候选选项、数值分箱或图像区域作为类别，直接利用骨干模型预训练的 query/key 投影打分，不增加参数。数值和点预测采用由粗到细分类，并用教师强制在一次前向中联合监督各阶段，同时结合长度感知全局批处理和跨 GPU 负载均衡提升训练吞吐。
ai_summary.result: 基于 Qwen3.5-4B 并在 1230 万问答对上训练后，MJev-Spatial 在八个测试模型中取得最高综合分 65.64%，在十二个基准中的七个排名第一，并在全部十二个基准上优于未修改的自回归基座模型；推理速度比最快自回归基线快 2.5 倍，比基座模型快 5.6 倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是把空间理解统一为无额外参数的原生注意力匹配分类，并用单次前向完成决策，避免生成式解码和答案解析。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为空间智能和具身智能中的低延迟空间判断提供了更高效的 System 1 式多模态决策范式，对实时视觉语言应用有参考价值。

papers.title: MMSearch-OPD: Easy Made Hard, Hard Made Learnable for Long-Horizon Multimodal Search Agents
papers.abstract: Multimodal deep search is moving from short queries to long-horizon investigations that continually acquire evidence. However, training such agents remains constrained by limited challenging training questions and insufficient process feedback.   We introduce MMSearch-OPD, combining controllable data refinement with joint reinforcement learning (RL) and on-policy distillation (OPD). Our Refine pipeline performs targeted expansion of reasoning chains derived from existing simple multimodal questions. Parameterized transformations control search depth and cross-modal evidence requirements while reusing existing image--question pairs. For training, answer rewards and lightweight behavior penalties guide RL, while the reward gap modulates token-level teacher guidance on imperfect student trajectories. An exponentially decaying distillation coefficient reduces teacher dependence as training proceeds.   Experiments show gains from data refinement and further improvements from joint training after SFT, indicating stronger long-horizon multimodal deep search capabilities.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态深度搜索智能体正从短查询走向需要持续获取证据的长程调查任务，但训练此类智能体面临高质量难题稀缺、过程反馈不足两大瓶颈。
ai_summary.method: 提出 MMSearch-OPD 框架：一方面用可控的 Refine 数据流水线，对现有简单多模态问答的推理链做参数化扩展，控制搜索深度与跨模态证据需求；另一方面联合强化学习与同策略蒸馏（OPD），用答案奖励加轻量行为惩罚引导 RL，并以奖励差调节 token 级教师指导，蒸馏系数指数衰减以逐步降低对教师的依赖。
ai_summary.result: 实验表明数据精炼本身即带来提升，在 SFT 之后再进行联合训练可进一步提升效果，验证了智能体长程多模态深度搜索能力的增强。
ai_summary.novelty: 将'简单题可控加难'的数据精炼与 RL+同策略蒸馏的联合训练结合，用奖励差调制教师指导并指数衰减教师依赖，缓解了长程多模态搜索的训练数据与过程反馈难题。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态搜索/深度研究型 Agent 提供了一条低成本构造难例并稳定训练长程推理能力的可复用路径。

papers.title: Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation for Unified Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit specialized visual capabilities in vision-language models (VLMs), yet jointly optimizing heterogeneous objectives often introduces cross-capability gradient conflicts. Training experts independently mitigates this interference, but direct reward optimization may entangle specialized knowledge with reward-hacking biases. This paper proposes Skill-Decoupled On-Policy Expert Distillation (SCOPED), which trains capability-specific experts and extracts explicit skills through reward-guided reflection. During on-policy distillation, these skills guide expert supervision while remaining unavailable to the unified student, encouraging it to internalize procedural knowledge without explicit skills at inference time. Across eight multimodal benchmarks, SCOPED consistently outperforms the backbone and mixed-capability RL, demonstrating the effectiveness of skill-decoupled on-policy expert distillation for integrating independently acquired capabilities. Further analyses reveal interference during joint capability optimization and suggest that skill augmentation promotes more consistent expert trajectories, greater attention to task-relevant visual evidence, and better preservation of specialized expertise in the unified student. All code and data are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/SCOPED.

ai_summary.problem: 在统一视觉语言模型中联合优化多种异构视觉能力时，强化学习容易产生跨能力梯度冲突；而独立训练专家又可能把专门知识与奖励黑客偏见纠缠在一起。本文旨在将独立获得的能力有效整合进统一模型，且推理时无需显式技能。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SCOPED：先训练能力特定专家，并通过奖励引导的反思提取显式技能；再采用 on-policy 蒸馏，让这些技能指导专家监督，但不提供给统一学生模型，促使学生内化程序性知识。
ai_summary.result: 在八个多模态基准上，SCOPED 稳定优于骨干模型和混合能力强化学习；分析表明技能增强能减少联合优化干扰、提升对任务相关视觉证据的关注，并更好保留学生模型中的专门能力。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是技能解耦的 on-policy 专家蒸馏：用可提取但不暴露给学生的技能作为蒸馏脚手架，实现多能力整合并避免推理时依赖显式技能。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多能力视觉语言模型的后训练与能力整合提供了一种可扩展范式，缓解异构目标联合优化中的干扰和奖励投机问题。
ai_summary.org: 东北大学（NEUIR）

papers.title: MOSS: Mode-Oriented Source Shaping for Robot Flow Matching Policies
papers.abstract: In robotic manipulation, the same observation often admits multiple feasible actions. Generative policies such as diffusion and flow matching naturally capture such multimodal behaviors, yet which mode is executed is left to random sampling and cannot be actively controlled. We propose Mode-Oriented Source Shaping (MOSS), which turns mode selection into an explicit choice of where generation starts. We first reveal, both empirically and theoretically, that deterministic flow transport induces mode-dependent structure in the source space. Under ideal deterministic ODE transport, distinct behavioral modes have distinct source-space preimages, while practical approximation errors can blur their boundaries due to imbalanced data, limited model capacity, and few inference steps. Motivated by this source-space structure, MOSS constructs semantically aligned mode-specific Gaussian sources that encode mode identity in the initial noise. A modality-strength estimator predicts the local degree of multimodality, which adaptively controls the geometry of the mode-specific sources. It contracts them toward a shared Gaussian where behaviors are similar and separates them near behavioral branching points. During deployment, the desired behavior is selected at inference simply by sampling from the corresponding component. Across 6 simulated and 3 real-world manipulation tasks, MOSS steers to the target mode up to 100% of the time with high task success, recovers minority modes at over 90% guidance rate under a 10:90 imbalance dataset, and surpasses mode-conditioned flow policy by 43.3 points of guidance rate on real robots.

ai_summary.problem: 同一观测对应多种可行动作时，扩散/流匹配策略虽能建模多模态行为，但执行哪个模式由随机采样决定、无法主动控制。
ai_summary.method: 论文揭示确定性流传输会在源空间形成模式相关结构，进而提出MOSS：为不同模式构建语义对齐的专属高斯源，把模式身份编码到初始噪声中；并用模态强度估计器自适应控制这些源的几何（相似行为收缩、分支点分离），部署时通过选择对应源分量实现模式控制。
ai_summary.result: 在6个仿真和3个真实机器人操作任务中，MOSS最高100%引导到目标模式且保持高成功率；在10:90不平衡数据下以超90%引导率恢复少数模式，并在真实机器人上比模式条件流策略高43.3个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 将生成模式的主动选择转化为对初始源空间/噪声分布的显式塑造与控制。
ai_summary.relevance: 提升了多模态生成式机器人策略的可控性与少数模式恢复能力，对具身智能和机器人操作有直接意义。

papers.title: REKI: Registering Knowledge in VLAs
papers.abstract: We introduce REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) pretrained exclusively on public data that sets a new Pareto frontier between performance and model size: on LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin Clean2Rand and RoboCasa365, it is outperformed only by models about twice its size. REKI consists of a vision-language model (VLM) followed by a flow-matching action expert, and is pretrained on a curated mixture of public robot, egocentric human and vision-language data. Additionally, we endow it with a memory that gives the policy access to its recent past at negligible cost: a few register tokens in the action expert summarise the output of the VLM at each frame and persist in the expert's cache. This memory improves success in simulation and on real robots, and makes oscillations between poses about four times rarer. REKI uses a simple model design and training paradigm, and is optimised to be efficient at training and inference. We release the full code across data curation, training, inference and evaluation, deployment, and all pretrained and finetuned model weights: https://github.com/kyutai-labs/reki.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）往往依赖规模巨大的模型和私有数据才能取得好性能，而且缺少对近期历史的记忆，导致策略在相邻位姿之间来回振荡、真实机器人上的成功率下降。
ai_summary.method: 提出 REKI，一个 2.4B 参数的 VLA：先用视觉语言模型（VLM）编码当前帧，再由一个使用 flow-matching 的动作专家输出动作；训练数据完全来自经过筛选的公开数据混合，包括机器人数据、第一人称人类数据和视觉语言数据。为动作专家引入少量 register token，用它们压缩 VLM 每帧的输出，并把结果缓存在动作专家的缓存中；这样策略就能以极低开销访问最近的过去。
ai_summary.result: 在 LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin Clean2Rand 和 RoboCasa365 上，只有参数量约为 REKI 两倍的模型才能超过它；同时在性能与模型规模之间形成了新的 Pareto 前沿。记忆机制提升了仿真和真机上的成功率，并使相邻位姿之间的振荡减少约 4 倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 用动作专家中的少量持久化 register token 实现低成本的帧级历史记忆，并以极简架构和纯公开数据在性能与规模之间取得新的平衡。
ai_summary.relevance: 为高效、可复现的开源 VLA 提供了强基线，说明用公开数据和轻量记忆机制就能在机器人与具身智能任务上逼近更大模型。
ai_summary.org: Kyutai（代码仓库 kyutai-labs/reki）

papers.title: Realtime-Bench: Can Frontier Models Solve Real-time Interactive Problems?
papers.abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. These findings suggest directions for improving real-time multimodal agents, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

ai_summary.problem: 现有实时流式模型的评测主要关注对话质量和流式感知，缺乏在严格时间约束下检验智能体能否及时采取有效行动的基准，因此无法判断前沿模型是否真正能解决实时交互任务。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Realtime-Bench，一套精心设计的动态任务集，延迟行动会直接影响任务成败；通过三种时钟设定进行评测：Wall Clock（按真实推理延迟推进环境时间）、Paused Clock（消除推理延迟的理想参考）和 Token Clock（按生成 token 数推进模拟时间，以独立于物理服务速度考查时间感知）。
ai_summary.result: 在 Wall Clock 下最佳成功率仅 44%，最佳 Pass^3 仅 36%；时间代价会限制动态环境中的成功，且更高推理强度在时间压力下效果参差，体现决策质量与及时执行之间的权衡。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将真实推理延迟纳入环境时间推进，并用三种时钟解耦服务延迟与模型实时流式能力，系统评测时间约束下的有效行动。
ai_summary.relevance: 为实时多模态智能体的时间感知、自适应推理与持续感知-行动能力提供了诊断性评测基准和改进方向。
ai_summary.org: 未知（作者未提供机构信息）

papers.title: FastVLA: Task-Conditioned and Temporally Adaptive Visual Token Compression for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models present a promising paradigm for general-purpose robot manipulation, but closed-loop deployment is often limited by inference efficiency: at each timestep, high-resolution, often multi-view images are encoded into hundreds of visual tokens that dominate transformer computation and latency. Token compression via attention is a natural solution but is challenging for VLA control because (1) decision-critical tokens are determined by the task, not generic visual saliency, and (2) the token budget varies substantially across steps, so static metrics and budgets waste computation or discard control-critical tokens. We introduce FastVLA, a training-free, task-aware, and temporally adaptive visual token compression framework. At each step, FastVLA scores token importance via task-to-vision attention and adaptively sets the compression rate from the importance-distribution uniformity, measured by an inverse-Simpson metric with online sliding-window calibration. We evaluate FastVLA on OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, and CogACT across LIBERO and SIMPLER, and on a physical Franka Research 3 robot. In simulation, it reduces LLM-backbone FLOPs by 35-59\% and action latency by 9-32\% (a 1.09$\times$-1.46$\times$ speedup) while maintaining task success, achieving a comparable or better efficiency-performance trade-off than existing plug-and-play token compression/pruning/reuse baselines. On the real robot, it cuts end-to-end latency by 20\% (1.25$\times$ speedup) at comparable success. Code is available at https://github.com/jiuyixu25/FastVLA.

ai_summary.problem: VLA模型在闭环机器人操作中推理效率受限：每步需将高分辨率、多视角图像编码为大量视觉token，主导Transformer计算与延迟；现有基于注意力的token压缩难以适配VLA，因为关键token由任务决定且各步token预算变化大。
ai_summary.method: 提出FastVLA，一种无需训练的、任务感知且时间自适应的视觉token压缩框架。每步通过task-to-vision attention评估token重要性，并利用inverse-Simpson指标衡量重要性分布均匀性，结合在线滑动窗口校准自适应设定压缩率。
ai_summary.result: 在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT和CogACT及LIBERO、SIMPLER仿真中，减少LLM主干FLOPs 35-59%、动作延迟9-32%（1.09-1.46倍加速），保持任务成功率；在真实Franka Research 3机器人上端到端延迟降低20%（1.25倍加速），成功率相当。
ai_summary.novelty: 将视觉token压缩从通用显著性转为任务条件重要性，并用重要性分布均匀性实现逐时间步自适应压缩率，且无需额外训练。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA模型提供即插即用的推理加速方法，有助于推动具身智能在真实机器人闭环部署中的效率与实用性。
ai_summary.org: Texas A&M University

papers.title: LAMP: Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors for Training-Free Few-Shot Vision-Language Adaptation
papers.abstract: Few-shot adaptation often relies on an encoder's final global representation, leaving complementary information in intermediate layers underused. Combining these features is challenging because their dimensions can differ and their usefulness varies across tasks. We propose LAMP, Layerwise Adaptive Mixing of Predictors, a training-free framework that combines global and regional information from multiple encoder layers. A single forward pass per view supplies all descriptors. Global and support-calibrated regional kernel predictors independently fit the same label residuals. Labeled validation data select their mixture in class-score space, preserving native feature dimensions without learned projections. LAMP-F further adapts text-anchored class prototypes, using a cached response to update the fixed-kernel residual predictions exactly. Experiments cover eleven datasets and ViT and ResNet backbones. LAMP achieves state-of-the-art mean accuracy among the compared published training-free ResNet-50 methods at 4, 8, and 16 shots, reaching 78.73% at 16 shots. Averaged across five support budgets, LAMP improves over a paired global-feature-only baseline by 1.14 and 1.59 percentage points on ViT-B/16 and ResNet-50; LAMP-F raises these gains to 1.96 and 2.54 points. LAMP-F reaches 16-shot accuracies of 83.57% and 79.10%, respectively. Controlled experiments identify multi-layer integration as the main source of improvement and examine pooling, calibration, validation labels, and computational cost. These findings show that combining layer-specific predictions can exploit complementary features from frozen encoders to improve few-shot classification.

ai_summary.problem: 少样本视觉-语言适配通常只利用编码器最终层全局表示，忽略中间层互补信息；而融合多层特征又受维度不一致和任务相关性变化影响。
ai_summary.method: 提出免训练的 LAMP 框架，结合多层编码器的全局与区域信息：每个视图一次前向得到描述子，全局预测器与支持集校准的区域核预测器分别拟合标签残差，并用带标签验证集在类别分数空间选择混合权重。LAMP-F 进一步利用缓存响应精确更新文本锚定类原型与固定核残差预测。
ai_summary.result: 在11个数据集及ViT/ResNet骨干上，LAMP平均优于仅全局特征基线1.14/1.59个百分点，LAMP-F提升至1.96/2.54个百分点；16-shot分别达83.57%和79.10%，并在免训练ResNet-50方法中4/8/16-shot平均准确率领先，16-shot为78.73%。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是无需训练投影或微调，通过验证集自适应混合多层全局与区域核预测器，充分挖掘冻结编码器的层间互补特征。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明冻结视觉-语言编码器的多层互补信息可显著提升少样本分类，为免训练多模态适配提供了简单有效的新思路。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日论文几乎全面聚焦具身智能与多模态基础模型的交叉：世界模型（5篇）与视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、GUI智能体、空间推理构成主线。研究重心从“训练更大的模型”转向“测试时适配与闭环自演化”，例如测试时环境潜变量优化、策略与数据引擎协同演化、自博弈蒸馏。同时，验证器、奖励与评测体系（3D内容验证、规则化分级验证器、实时延迟基准）成为支撑能力提升的关键环节。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日筛选出的论文中没有大厂（Google、Meta、OpenAI、阿里、字节等）的署名论文，因此不存在方向重合；唯一明确的机构是 Stanford（T2-z，世界模型测试时优化）。其余论文均来自未标注或非大厂机构，只能看出研究社区的方向分布：世界模型、VLA、多模态智能体、空间推理、高效推理，暂无法与大厂路线做方法级对比。
daily_insight.signals: 1）世界模型论文占比高，且明显从“生成视频”转向“可规划、可验证、可解耦视角的状态建模”（GeoState、OmniVerifier-C1、Velox）；2）测试时优化与训练无关的适配方法集中出现（T2-z、FastVLA、LAMP、Velox），说明算力受限下“推理期智能”成为新战场；3）验证器与分级奖励模型正在形成独立子方向，服务世界模型与智能体；4）真实延迟被纳入基准（Realtime-Bench），实时性开始成为评测维度；5）具身数据获取转向“监督式玩耍/自博弈+数据引擎闭环”，数据与策略协同演化成为共识路线。
